# Session Startup

Use this skill at the beginning of a new work session to restore project
continuity from `Session_starter.md`.

1. Read `../../../Session_starter.md`.
2. Summarize the current state, active constraints, and next actionable steps.
3. Follow the documented technical decisions and architectural patterns.
4. Update the session file as work produces durable decisions or progress.
